text.Command Center:
How to Play ==
When you play Command Center you put an Outpost in play with a defense of 4. Gain 2 Trade and whenever you play a Star Empire ship, gain 2 Combat.
 Strategy ==
If you do not have any other Star Empire cards in your deck, Command Center is a decent outpost in early game when it may last several turns. In that case it becomes significantly less valuable later in the game, when it is easily taken out due to its relatively weak defense. However, in a predominantly Star Empire deck it can generate a significant amount of damage, especially when you have two of them in play (or copy it with a Stealth Tower). In that case it can also be a good purchase later in the game.
